summary: Native addon embeds Chromium cookie/login database extraction primitives and HTTPS uploader
details: The package ships a single ~10MB Rust-compiled napi ELF addon (tools.linux-x64-gnu.node) whose binary contents embed Chromium browser-credential-database schemas and access strings: the Cookies table schema fragment (host_key, top_frame_site_key, has_cross_site_ancestor, encrypted_value) and a 'Found login for' string consistent with Login Data parsing. The same binary bundles a hyper/ureq/rustls HTTP client with a range-request downloader. Package metadata is deceptive: name is generic (new-native-tools-linux-x64-gnu), version carries a Unix-timestamp suffix (-1786011509), README is a one-line stub, and package.json has no author, repository, description, or dependencies — a shape consistent with a platform-optional native payload staged for a parent package. The Chromium cookies-table columns plus Login Data parsing plus a bundled outbound HTTP client is the canonical fingerprint of a browser credential stealer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
